urdu: فاروق احمد خان لغاری نے صدر بننے کے بعد کس جماعت کی رکنیت سے استعفیٰ دیا؟
english: Which party membership did Farooq Ahmed Khan Leghari resign from after becoming President?
roman_1: Farooq Ahmed Khan Leghari ney sadar banne ke baad kis jamaat ki rukniyat se isteefa diya?
roman_2: Farooq Ahmad Khan Leghari ne saddar banne ke baad kis party ki rukniat se istefa diya?
roman_3: Farooq Ahmed Khan Leghari nay sadir banne k baad kis jamaat ki rukniyat se istifa diya?
